name: Telah
overview: Telah was a male member of the tribe of Ephraim, known primarily as a son of Ephraim. The biblical record of Telah is concise, identifying him through his paternal lineage without additional narrative or descriptive details.
namesAndTitles: The name Telah is a proper name meaning "fissure, split, fracture." There is no indication that this name was given directly by God, but its Hebrew meaning may reflect characteristics or circumstances associated with the individual or his family.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records that Telah was the father of Resheph, establishing a direct paternal relationship. Beyond this, no other family relationships are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Telah's significance lies in his place within the genealogical records of the tribe of Ephraim, serving as a link in the lineage that traces the descendants of one of Joseph's sons. While the biblical text does not elaborate on his personal deeds, his mention preserves the continuity of God's covenant people through the generations.
